title: entrepta.json
description: Config the entrepta CLI writes with init and reads with add.

theme.description: The preset init wrote. The default when all six are installed.

themes.description: single writes one fixed theme; all writes the six, switchable with data-theme.

srcDir.description: Where @/ points, such as src in Vite. Aliases resolve relative to it.

rsc.description: Whether the project uses React Server Components.

css.description: The global CSS file init writes the tokens into.

aliases.description: Import paths. Plain paths only: they are written into import lines.
